newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Province objects Argentine airport sale - report.
newsitem.headline: Province objects Argentine airport sale - report.

text.p: Argentine's Buenos Aires province has written to President Carlos Menem objecting to plans to privatize the airport of the city of Mar del Plata, a newspaper reported Friday.
The letter argues that the airport belongs to Buenos Aires province and not the national government, La Nacion reported.

No Buenos Aires province or national presidency spokesman was immediately available to confirm the report, but Buenos Aires Gov. Eduardo Duhalde has previously said he was concerned by plans to privatize Mar del Plata's Camet airport.
President Carlos Menem included Camet in a decree to privatize 36 of the country's airports he signed June 2.
Argentina is seeking bids for a single, 30-year concession for the airports, to be awarded in October.
